entries.symptom: Every Jest suite fails with a Flow syntax error in @react-native/jest-preset/jest/setup.js
entries.cause: babel.config.js is missing, so jest-expo cannot transform React Native
entries.fix: Create babel.config.js (presets: babel-preset-expo; the canonical file)

entries.symptom: SyntaxError: Cannot use import statement outside a module (react-intl, @formatjs, intl-messageformat, standard-navigation, expo-router routes)
entries.cause: An ESM-only package is not in the transformIgnorePatterns allowlist (expo-router 57 imports standard-navigation, so every route test and every test that imports expo-notifications needs it)
entries.fix: Add the package to the allowlist in jest.config.js (the canonical TRANSPILE_PACKAGES)
match: Cannot use import statement outside a module

entries.symptom: TurboModuleRegistry.getEnforcing(...): '<Module>' could not be found, or Cannot find native module '<X>' in Jest
entries.cause: A test imported a library whose native module does not exist in Jest (ads, keyboard controller, audio), or the module calls requireNativeModule at import time
entries.fix: Give the library a root manual mock in __mocks__/ (applied without jest.mock) or test through the fake port; in your own native adapters use requireOptionalNativeModule inside the factory

entries.symptom: Native Skia Module failed to correctly install JSI Bindings!
entries.cause: Skia was imported in the unit project (jest-expo environment)
entries.fix: Test geometry as pure functions; pixel tests go in the golden project (Skia's jestEnv)

entries.symptom: After setting Skia's jestEnv globally, React Native tests misbehave and every file loads CanvasKit
entries.cause: Skia's jestEnv extends jest-environment-node and replaces React Native's environment for every test
entries.fix: Use Jest projects: unit (jest-expo) and golden (*.golden.test.ts with the Skia env)

entries.symptom: Cannot find module react-native-reanimated/jest/resolver
entries.cause: That path exists only in newer Reanimated docs, not in 4.5
entries.fix: jest.setup: Gesture Handler's jestSetup, jest.mock('react-native-worklets', () => require('react-native-worklets/src/mock')), require('react-native-reanimated').setUpTests()

entries.symptom: <AudioManager method> is not a function in tests
entries.cause: The audio library's own mock lags its API
entries.fix: Extend it in the root mock and re-check on every bump

entries.symptom: TypeError: <SDK>.<method> is not a function in a test, after an SDK bump or a copied mock
entries.cause: An older copy of a root mock lacks a member the code calls
entries.fix: Keep one mock per library in __mocks__/ and update it with the SDK; delete copies

entries.symptom: performance.now() timings in Jest are coarse
entries.cause: The preset's performance.now mock has 1 ms resolution
entries.fix: Measure fast code over many iterations; real timings come from device runs (test/**/*.perf.test.ts with node:perf_hooks)

entries.symptom: I18nManager.isRTL is false in every Jest test
entries.cause: The React Native Jest preset mocks it
entries.fix: Test RTL through an explicit direction option of the test render helper; layout itself is checked on a device

entries.symptom: A mock expected once is called 2 or 4 times (calls from earlier tests in the file)
entries.cause: The Jest config lacks clearMocks and restoreMocks
entries.fix: Use the canonical jest.config.js (clearMocks and restoreMocks on); never reset by hand in each test

entries.symptom: jest-haste-map: duplicate manual mock found: <package>
entries.cause: Jest indexed an installed skills folder, whose fixtures ship __mocks__ with the app's package names
entries.fix: Ignore skills/ and the agent folders (.agents, .claude ...) in modulePathIgnorePatterns and testPathIgnorePatterns, as the canonical jest.config.js does

entries.symptom: jest --selectProjects unit <file> runs the whole suite instead of the file
entries.cause: Jest reads every word after --selectProjects as another project name
entries.fix: Put the paths first: npx jest <file> --selectProjects unit

entries.symptom: Cannot find module '@/...' only when Jest starts outside the repo root (Stryker sandbox, another working directory)
entries.cause: jest-expo derives the @/ mapper from tsconfig.json only in the working directory and not through extends
entries.fix: Spell out the aliases in jest.config.js moduleNameMapper (the canonical file does)

entries.symptom: A number test passes before the Intl polyfills exist and fails after (Latin digits where Node printed native digits, or the reverse)
entries.cause: The forced FormatJS polyfills format without Node's ICU, so a tag without -u-nu- formats differently
entries.fix: Pin the numbering system in the locale tag, or assert through the app formatter; never rely on Node ICU behaviour

entries.symptom: npm run test:coverage fails for some seeds only
entries.cause: It runs Jest with --randomize, which shuffles tests inside a file too; a test left files or state behind for a later one
entries.fix: Make each test clean up what it wrote (afterEach) and never depend on order

entries.symptom: toStrictEqual fails on records that look equal in a property test
entries.cause: fast-check's fc.record can build null-prototype objects; a spread turns them into plain ones
entries.fix: Map records through ({ ...value }) when the property compares a transformed copy

entries.symptom: act() warnings or empty screens in RNTL 14 tests
entries.cause: RNTL 14 render, fireEvent and user events are async
entries.fix: await render(), await user.press(), await fireEvent.press(); when every call is already awaited and the warning stays, look for a store reset in afterEach (testing-store-reset-after-each)

entries.symptom: Every run logs 'An update to TestComponent inside a test was not wrapped in act(...)' from a hook or screen test whose afterEach resets a module-level store (a Zustand store's setState or a reset helper), although every RNTL call is awaited
entries.cause: Jest runs the test file's afterEach before React Testing Library's own cleanup unmounts what the test rendered, so the reset publishes to a still-mounted subscriber outside act()
entries.fix: Reset the module-level store in beforeEach instead of afterEach (the next test starts clean and nothing is mounted yet); never wrap the reset in act() or silence the warning. Rerun the file and npm run test:coverage until no act warning is left

entries.symptom: expect(screen).toHavePathname throws 'screen.getPathname is not a function'
entries.cause: expo-router's testing-library was written for RNTL 13; with RNTL 14 the screen object lacks its helpers, and fake timers leak between renderRouter tests
entries.fix: Assert the path through the object renderRouter returns (or the route's rendered root testID); use real timers in router tests

entries.symptom: getByRole cannot find a View that has a role
entries.cause: A plain View is found by role only when it is accessible
entries.fix: Set accessible on the View (Pressable is accessible by default)

entries.symptom: A component test cannot find the testID of a decorative part (an icon, an illustration)
entries.cause: Decorative parts are hidden from screen readers, and RNTL skips hidden elements by default
entries.fix: Query them with { includeHiddenElements: true }; interactive elements stay visible to screen readers

entries.symptom: A screen test expects "Premium - active" but renders "Premium – active"
entries.cause: The catalog text uses an en dash; the test typed a hyphen
entries.fix: Assert the catalog text through the message key (or copy it exactly)

entries.symptom: A component test throws on a missing message id
entries.cause: In tests the i18n onError throws, so a missing key fails the test run
entries.fix: Add the key to every catalog of the app's locales and rerun the catalog check

entries.symptom: New snapshot was not written. The update flag must be explicitly passed
entries.cause: jest --ci (the default when CI=1) never writes snapshots
entries.fix: Create or update goldens deliberately with jest <file> -u and a Gate-Change trailer

entries.symptom: npx jest --selectProjects golden <file> -u rewrote every golden in the project
entries.cause: The path after --selectProjects is read as a project name, so -u applies to every golden test
entries.fix: Always npx jest <file> --selectProjects golden -u; restore the other goldens from git

entries.symptom: Jest exits 1 with "1 snapshot obsolete" although every test passed
entries.cause: Jest 29.7 fails the run on obsolete snapshot entries in --ci
entries.fix: Remove the entry with the path-first -u command for that file, or restore the test that owned it

entries.symptom: jest -u writes snapshots to *.snap.ios (or *.snap.android) files that the gate does not know
entries.cause: The jest-expo platform presets add the platform suffix next to the test
entries.fix: List **/*.golden.test.ts.snap.ios and .snap.android in gatedPaths (the canonical quality-gates.json does); commit golden changes with a Gate-Change trailer

entries.symptom: A pixel golden passes although a two-digit label is missing
entries.cause: A 0.1 % tolerance is about 220 pixels on a 390x560 canvas; a small label is fewer
entries.fix: Add recording-canvas assertions for every label, or a pixel-count threshold for text goldens

entries.symptom: Text is missing in Jest golden images
entries.cause: Skia's jest setup mocks useFonts and matchFont to null
entries.fix: Load the TTF with Skia.Typeface.MakeFreeTypeFaceFromData in text golden tests

entries.symptom: Simulator or emulator screenshot baselines differ after an Xcode, iOS runtime or system image change
entries.cause: Rendering differs across runtime versions
entries.fix: Tie baselines to one device model and runtime per platform and regenerate them deliberately with a Gate-Change trailer

entries.symptom: Jest: Coverage data for ./src/<folder>/ was not found (exit 1)
entries.cause: A coverageThreshold key names a folder that has no files yet
entries.fix: Add per-folder threshold keys only when the folder has source files (filter the keys with fs.globSync, as the canonical config does)
match: Coverage data for .+ was not found

entries.symptom: npm run test:coverage fails a global threshold right after adopting templates: Jest: "global" coverage threshold for statements (90%) not met: 83.8%
entries.cause: Files that ship neither a test nor the device-only marker count at 0 % (native adapters, Skia and frame-callback modules, composition files, model hooks)
entries.fix: Give each file a test, or (native, Skia, frame-callback and composition files only) the line "// device-only: covered by <e2e flow or device check>" in its first 6 lines; never lower a threshold or hand-write coveragePathIgnorePatterns

entries.symptom: A subset run with --coverage exits 1: Jest: "global" coverage threshold for statements (90%) not met: 0% (or a few %), although every test passed
entries.cause: The root config's thresholds count every file collectCoverageFrom names, and the subset ran only a few
entries.fix: Only npm run test:coverage judges thresholds; for a subset: npx jest <paths> --coverage --collectCoverageFrom='<path>/**/*.ts' --coverageThreshold='{}'

entries.symptom: The test check reports untested-module for a helper tested only through its caller
entries.cause: The rule is "every pure module has its own test"; a caller's test does not count
entries.fix: Write a small direct test next to the module; the device-only marker is only for wrappers Jest cannot load

entries.symptom: Stryker's initial run fails on a file with a file-level 'worklet' directive ("stryNS_..." is read-only), or a related test throws useAnimatedStyle was used without a dependency array or Babel plugin
entries.cause: Stryker injects helpers that the Worklets plugin then workletizes; turning the plugin off for every file breaks Reanimated in the files Stryker did not mutate
entries.fix: Turn the Worklets/Reanimated Babel plugins off only for the files that hold Stryker's namespace (the canonical babel.config.js does)
match: without a dependency array or Babel plugin

entries.symptom: Stryker copies thousands of files into its sandbox and every mutant run is slow
entries.cause: The sandbox included skills/ and the agent folders
entries.fix: Add them to ignorePatterns in stryker.config.json

entries.symptom: Stryker reports a mutation score of NaN (or runs no mutant) and the run passes
entries.cause: Only static mutants were found or every mutant was ignored, so nothing ran; a NaN score is not a pass
entries.fix: Check the mutate globs and the static-mutant setting; a mutation gate treats NaN or zero mutants as a failure

entries.symptom: Mutants survive in code covered only by property tests
entries.cause: Determinism and range properties do not pin exact outputs
entries.fix: Add golden example values next to every property test

entries.symptom: A test using node:sqlite, Buffer or node:fs fails tsc inside src/
entries.cause: The app program carries only jest types (no Node globals in app code)
entries.fix: Put Node-API tests and drivers under test/ (for example test/sqlite/)

entries.symptom: The test check reports nondeterminism for performance.now() in a speed test
entries.cause: Only test/**/*.perf.test.ts files may time real work, with performance imported from node:perf_hooks
entries.fix: Move the timing test to test/<area>/<name>.perf.test.ts and import performance from node:perf_hooks

entries.symptom: expo-sqlite fails in Jest
entries.cause: The native module does not run in Jest
entries.fix: Keep SQL behind the SqlDriver port and test the real SQL on node:sqlite (test/sqlite/); the device check is the final proof
